lines.say: switches on GLP-1 receptors: more insulin, less excess glucagon when blood sugar is high
stomach emptying slows; nausea in 44% versus 18% on placebo, plus vomiting and diarrhea
about 0.5 to 1.0 points lower HbA1c than placebo; antibodies can weaken this
no rise in heart attacks, strokes or cardiovascular deaths in 14,752 adults; no fall shown
0.3 to 2.7 kg more weight lost than placebo (not approved for weight loss)
kidney function checked if vomiting or diarrhea is severe; dehydration can injure them
boxed warning (extended-release form): thyroid C-cell tumors in rats; unknown in humans
gallbladder disease such as gallstones, a label warning
low blood sugar is more likely with insulin or a sulfonylurea, so it's checked
rare drug-caused low platelets, sometimes fatal bleeding; reports of high INR on warfarin

ask: How would we tell if antibodies are making it work less well for me?
